净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Simplified mutation of drawdown_depth_atr_adaptive: removes the volatility expansion ratio modifier to target the pure drawdown depth/ATR signal. By eliminating the adaptive weight, the factor becomes more directly interpretable and may improve IC by reducing noise from the secondary component. The core contrarian drawdown mechanism is preserved. Uses talib.ATR for efficient true range calculation

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

depth = (close / ts_max(63, close) - 1) * -1; normalized = depth / ts_mean(63, TR); factor = normalized
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

depth = (close / ts_max(63, close) - 1) * -1; normalized = depth / ts_mean(63, TR); factor = normalized
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_max(close) → 窗口 63 的滚动最大值 (与m_max相同)
  2. 步骤2：divide(close, v1(ts_max)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  3. 步骤3：subtract(v2(divide), 1) → 减法：x - y
  4. 步骤4：neg(1) → 返回-x
  5. 步骤5：multiply(v3(subtract), v4(neg)) → 乘法：x × y
  6. 步骤6：ts_mean(TR) → 窗口 63 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  7. 步骤7：divide(v5(multiply), v6(ts_mean)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
TR真实波幅（true_range 简称，max(H-L,|H-C|,|L-C|)）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 peak：close.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).max()
  2. 计算 dd：(close - peak) / peak
  3. 计算 depth：(-dd)
  4. 计算 atr_63：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=63)
  5. 计算 normalized_depth：depth / atr_63
  6. 计算 factor：normalized_depth

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_depth_atr(df): df_copy = df.copy() peak = df_copy["close"].rolling(63, min_periods=63).max() dd = (df_copy["close"] - peak) / peak depth = (-dd) atr_63 = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"], timeperiod=63) normalized_depth = depth / atr_63.replace(0, np.nan) factor = normalized_depth.fillna(0) df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_depth_atr"]
